newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: NatFoods appoints chief financial officer.
newsitem.headline: NatFoods appoints chief financial officer.

text.p: National Foods Ltd on Tuesday said it had appointed former Victorian TAB chief executive Clive Hooke to the new position of chief financial officer.

Hooke, who was Victorian TAB head for a year from October 1993, would oversee a diverse range of responsibilities including strategy and planning, finance and administration and information technology, NatFood managing director Max Ould said in a statement.
NatFoods in March reported a net loss of A$12.31 million for the six months to December 31.
